meta.title: Institutional Well-being
meta.description: The Institutional Well-being area of UNC promotes comprehensive health, inclusion and retention of students, faculty and staff in the university setting.

hero.title: Institutional Well-being
hero.label: Academics · Well-being
hero.description: UNC looks after its community. The Institutional Well-being area supports students, faculty and staff in their overall development, promoting health, inclusion and quality of life on campus.

contactLabel: Need support or information about a service?

a1.title: Mental health
a1.description: Free psychological support service for students, faculty and staff. Individual care and workshops on stress management and emotional well-being.

a2.title: Inclusion and accessibility
a2.description: Programs and curricular adaptations to ensure the full participation of people with disabilities in university life.

a3.title: Scholarships and financial support
a3.description: Management of national and international scholarships, university canteens and financial support for students in vulnerable situations.

a4.title: Sports and recreation
a4.description: Sports activities, inter-faculty tournaments and leisure spaces that encourage healthy living in the university community.

a5.title: University coexistence
a5.description: Protocols to prevent violence and harassment, conflict mediation and promotion of an inclusive and respectful institutional climate.
